title: Game Day: Oilers vs Ducks, Thu Nov 5, 7PM MT | 6PM PT, Rogers Place
caption: The Oilers are 5-4-1 against Anaheim over the last 10 meetings and have outscored the Ducks 42-40, a stretch that includes the 2026 first-round series (Ducks won 4-2) and a 5-2 Oilers win at Honda Center on Oct 7. Draisaitl leads the way with 18 points in that span (3G, 15A), with McDavid at 16 and Bouchard at 15. Gauthier has 6 goals. The Ducks power play has gone 14/35 (40%) against Edmonton.
